toolDefinitions.terminalTool: submit_compilation (appended to the tool list; not counted against ToolBudget.maxToolCalls)

toolUseIdTracking: None beyond the current assistant message: each turn's tool_use blocks are read from message.content; ids are echoed into tool_result blocks only in the ordinary-tool branch (pre-fix) / in every continuation branch through toolResultsForAssistantTurn (post-fix). No cross-turn id ledger exists or is needed: the provider only requires the immediately-following user content to answer the preceding assistant turn.

turnLoop.detail: withRetry(stream(model,max_tokens,system,messages,tools).finalMessage()); a thrown error (rate-limit retries exhausted, 4xx, 5xx, gateway stream errors) -> PROVIDER_FAILURE (pre-fix: submission=null always).
toolUseBlocks = content.filter(tool_use); submitBlock = first tool_use named submit_compilation.

branches.name: schema failure
branches.transition: SubmitCompilationSchema.safeParse fails -> if stop_reason==max_tokens: OUTPUT_TRUNCATED (+ recoverPartialSubmission prefix) else MODEL_SCHEMA_FAILURE; terminal.

branches.name: retrieval nudge (3B.1 tool-under-use policy)
branches.condition: any rule/definition sufficiency in {UNSUPPORTED, MISSING_CONTEXT} AND toolRunner.log.length==0 AND remainingCalls>0 AND !retrievalNudgeUsed
branches.preFixTransition: messages.push(assistant content [contains submit tool_use]); messages.push(user PLAIN TEXT nudge); continue  <-- EARLIEST INCORRECT STATE TRANSITION: the assistant tool_use is followed by ordinary user text with no tool_result for its id; the next SEND is rejected by the provider (400) and the catch discards the already-parsed valid submission.
branches.postFixTransition: heldProvisional={parsed, raw}; messages.push(assistant content); messages.push(user [tool_result(submit id)=nudge text, tool_result(other ids)=tool outputs]); continue

branches.name: accept
branches.transition: finish(parsed submission, raw, log, telemetry, null, null); terminal (submission semantic status = whatever the model stated).

turnLoop.transition: messages.push(assistant); messages.push(user [one tool_result per tool_use via ToolRunner.run]); continue - protocol-valid before and after (now via the shared helper).
first time: push assistant + corrective user text (no tool_use present, so protocol-valid); second time: MODEL_SCHEMA_FAILURE terminal (post-fix: retains a held provisional submission).
maxTurns = maxToolCalls + 4 exhausted -> TOOL_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED terminal (post-fix: retains a held provisional submission).

sufficiencyEvaluation: parsed.data.rules[].sufficiency / definitions[].sufficiency compared to the strings UNSUPPORTED and MISSING_CONTEXT; never rewritten by the caller; compile.ts maps them to failureReasons UNSUPPORTED_SEMANTICS / MISSING_CONTEXT and to status (REVIEW_REQUIRED, never COMPLETED).
providerFailureClassification: Any exception from the stream call -> failureReason PROVIDER_FAILURE with failureDetail = error message; compile.ts: submission null -> status FAILED; submission present (post-fix retention) -> failureReasons include PROVIDER_FAILURE -> REVIEW_REQUIRED (or PARTIAL/FAILED per the other reasons).
earliestIncorrectTransition: retrieval-nudge branch: assistant(tool_use submit) -> user(plain text)
submitCompilationSemanticRole: C - terminal by default; provisional exactly once, only under the 3B.1 retrieval-nudge condition (the model is asked to try retrieval before finalizing). The prompt tells the model to call it exactly once; the caller's one-shot nudge is the single sanctioned continuation. The fix keeps that architecture and only changes the transport envelope of the nudge (tool_result instead of user text) plus retention of the held submission.
